{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
# QA orders have revenue = 999999.99
# Refunded orders have status = 'refunded'
# We are only interested in converted = 1, so we will filter by that
# But we must exclude QA and refunded rows from the analysis

# Create mask for rows to exclude
exclude_mask = (df['revenue'] == 999999.99) | (df['status'] == 'refunded')

# Filter to only converted = 1, and not excluded
converted_df = df[(df['converted'] == 1) & ~exclude_mask]

# Now check: what is the mean age of those who converted?
# But note: customer_age = -1 means missing, so we should exclude those from the mean

# Exclude rows where customer_age == -1
converted_valid_df = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = converted_valid_df['customer_age'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Number of converted customers: {len(converted_df)}")
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {len(converted_valid_df)}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age:.2f}")"}
